{{Map|2744,3155|2760,3063|mtype=pin|zoom=0|caption=Brimhaven Dungeon entrances|width=250|height=250|align=right}}
The '''Brimhaven Dungeon''' is an underground cave located south-west of [[Brimhaven]] on the [[members]]' portion of the island of [[Karamja]].

To enter the dungeon, players must pay [[Saniboch]], who is outside the entrance, 875 [[coins]] each time they wish to enter the dungeon. Alternatively, a one-off fee of 1,000,000 coins can be paid for permanent access. A player will also need an axe to cut the [[vines (Brimhaven Dungeon)|vines]] blocking the path (requiring level 10 [[Woodcutting]]). Vines can be cut by hand only when going towards the main exit to avoid trapping players. A [[blessed axe]] will not work. The closest bronze axe spawns in the [[Dead Man's Chest|Brimhaven bar]], if needed.

The [[Stepping stones (Western Brimhaven Dungeon)|stepping stones]] to the west of the vines in the dungeon require level 12 [[Agility]] to pass. If a player fails it (which is quite rare), they will get hit by a low amount of damage. To get further in the dungeon ([[Black demons|Black Demons]] and beyond), you will need at least a Woodcutting level of 34. With 56 Agility, the [[Stepping stones (Eastern Brimhaven Dungeon)|stepping stones]] south of the vines can be used to get to the [[red dragon]]s faster.

The cost of entering the dungeon can often be easily recouped, from the drops of the many powerful monsters in the dungeon like demons, giants, and dragons. The dungeon is a popular destination for players seeking to fight [[greater demon]]s, [[black demon]]s, [[red dragon]]s, or [[metal dragons]].

Another entrance to the dungeon can be found west of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]]. Guarded by Saniboch's sister [[Banisoch]], a one-time fee of 5,000 [[trading sticks]] must be given to her before she will allow players to use the entrance, either entering or exiting. This entrance takes players to the [[bronze dragon]] area. Players may smith the bars they receive as drops from the metal dragons on an anvil north-east from the entrance, if the player decides it's worth the walk.

A [[Dwarf multicannon]] may be used within the dungeon, although it is a single way combat zone.

==Transportation==
The dungeon can be reached by sailing from [[East Ardougne]] to [[Brimhaven]], for a fee of 30 coins or for free when using the [[Ring of Charos]]. Another sea route can be taken from [[Port Sarim]] to [[Musa Point]], again requiring 30 coins or the Ring of Charos for a free trip. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven. Alternatively, one can [[Charter ship|charter]] a ship to get to Brimhaven (the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).

The nearest bank, although completion of the quest [[Shilo Village]] and 10 extra coins are required, is [[Shilo Village bank]] which can be reached by using [[Hajedy]]'s [[Wheelbarrow cart|cart]]. The [[Tzhaar City]] is also an option.

Teleportation is also practical:
*[[Teleport to House]] if the [[player-owned house]] is in [[Brimhaven]] or if using a [[scroll of redirection]]. This is by far the quickest way to get to the dungeon, and best to get items lost on death back if the player dies.
*Using a [[Tai bwo wannai teleport]] scroll and running west to the alternate entrance. This requires paying [[Banisoch]] a one-time fee of 5,000 [[trading sticks]] (GE: {{Coins|{{GEP|Trading sticks}}*5000}}), and takes players to the [[bronze dragon]] area.
*[[Spirit tree]] if the player has a fully grown spirit tree behind the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] to Karamja, then run west then south.
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|CKR}} and then north to the dungeon.
*[[Ardougne Teleport]], take [[Captain Barnaby]]'s ship to Brimhaven (costs 30 coins). Walk south to the dungeon.

==Personalities==
*[[Saniboch]] - The guard to the main entrance of this dungeon. Players must pay him 875 coins to enter.
*[[Banisoch]] - Saniboch's sister, who guards another entrance of this dungeon west of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]]. Players must pay her a one-time fee of 5000 trading sticks to enter.
*[[Hieve]] - The elder cousin of [[Nieve]], he guards a massive metal dragon chamber and only allows those with the appropriate Slayer task to enter.

==Trivia==
* All shortcuts and obstacles in the dungeon, aside from one [[Vine (Brimhaven Dungeon)|vine]], have skill requirements only on one side. For example, the [[Stepping stones (Western Brimhaven Dungeon)|stepping stones]] require level 12 Agility to be traversed from the north, but have no requirements when approached from the south. Presumably this asymmetry was a measure taken to avoid players becoming stranded after a [[Temporary skill boost|stat boost]] wears off, prior to the addition of the [[Lumbridge Home Teleport|home teleport]] spell in 2006.
* The [[Wise Old Man]] once travelled to Karamja and ventured into Brimhaven Dungeon, which few people at the time dared to enter. Afterwards, he advised the locals to charge any adventurer who wished to enter the dungeon, which is why Saniboch charges a fee of 875 coins for any player to enter.
